text:
clara: Quick design check-in for the catalog compare flow. Two main asks from PM: keep filter state when switching between Compare and Explorer; and clarify how pinned versions surface across views. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/catalog-compare-pin-flow
rishi: Re: filter persistence 10. Users expect their active filters to stick when they bounce between views. Suggest storing filters in URL + local state so sharing links preserves context.
emma: For compare UX 10: if a user pins a version in Compare, should that pin be global (all catalog views) or scope-limited (only Compare)? My recommendation: pin per-user global by default, with a team-level toggle in settings.
dan: If pins are global they can clutter other views. Maybe use a subtle badge in Explorer that indicates "Pinned by you" and allow quick unpin from hover. Also consider a checkbox in the Compare header: "Show pinned only".
jordi: Badge ordering question: when multiple perf badges appear (latency, throughput, accuracy), what's the sort order? Current mock shows latency first but Product wants most-relevant-by-workload. Maybe let users set badge priority in their profile or infer from recent queries.
clara: Good points. Can we design a compact affordance that indicates a version is pinned without taking space? Thinking: a 6px vertical bar + SR label; expand to a full pin icon on hover/focus.
a11y-bot: Accessibility reminder: 6px indicator alone is not sufficient. Ensure there's a 44px focus target, visible focus ring, and ARIA label like "Pinned version, press Enter to unpin". Contrast for small indicators must meet 4.5:1.
emma: On copy: 'Pin version' vs 'Save to my view' vs 'Make default' 10: 'Pin version' is short and consistent with mental model. For team default, 'Set as team default' is explicit and requires confirmation.
rishi: Technical note: persist pin state server-side for cross-device consistency. Fall back to client-side for quick toggles. Expose an endpoint: POST /api/pins { user, modelId, versionId, scope }.
dan: Filter persistence: storing in URL makes deep links easy, but we should also update the browser history when filters change so back/forward is predictable. For ephemeral filters (like text search), maybe don't persist automatically unless user clicks 'Save filters'.
jordi: Badge priority setting: can be in account settings + a lightweight per-view override in the header. UI idea: small cog on the badge tray that opens a popover with drag handles to reorder.
emma: Performance badge contrast: mock uses pale gray for badge text. For 12px text in badges we need >=4.5:1. Propose switching to token --text-strong or using slightly darker bg with white text for high/low states.
a11y-bot: Also test screen reader flow: when pinning/unpinning, announce via aria-live region: "Version 2.1 pinned to your view." And ensure focus management on open/close of any popover.
clara: Action items: 1) I'll update figma: add persistent filter URL params + small pill UI for 'Saved filters' 2) add pin affordance: collapsed bar -> full icon on hover, focusable with aria-labels 3) badge tray: add cog for ordering and contrast tokens 4) PR spec will include API shape for pins and history guidance. Will post new preview tomorrow.
emma: Also please add a short paragraph in the design spec about expected pin scope behavior and admin perms for 'Set as team default'. QA will need that for policy checks.
dan: I'll sketch the header 'Show pinned only' toggle and the Explorer compact indicator for pinned items.
jordi: I'll prototype the badge reorder popover; will try to keep it keyboard draggable with up/down controls as well as mouse drag.
a11y-bot: Scheduling accessibility walkthrough for 2026-03-31 09:30 PT. Include dev and QA in invite. Checklist: focus order, live region messages, contrast, 44px targets, reduced motion.
clara: Thanks all. Ping here when previews are up and attach contrast token screenshots so a11y checks are quick. :sparkles:
